remarks:
Enjoy the convenience of downtown living in this fully furnished 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offering approximately 1,040 square feet at 210 Ellicott Street. This move-in-ready property combines urban convenience with a comfortable, thoughtfully furnished interior. The building features elevator access, while the unit offers the added convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. An off-street parking space is also included.

The extensive furnishings included in the sale make this a truly turnkey opportunity. Items include a couch, coffee table, tan leather accent chair, dining table with chairs and bench seating, two barstools, wine rack, entry table, shoe rack, office desk and chair, and Buffalo-themed artwork. The bedroom includes a bedroom set, new mattress, nightstands, and lamps. Two TVs and all appliances are included as well.

With its generous living space, convenient amenities, and central location near downtown Buffalo’s restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and local attractions, this condo offers an appealing opportunity for an owner-occupant or investor. Whether you’re looking for a furnished downtown residence or an investment opportunity, this property offers the convenience of a turnkey space in the heart of the city.
